thought.text: PHP 8.4 is available in the PPA. Installing PHP 8.4 with required extensions.

reasoning_content:
PPA has been added, and php8.4-cli 8.4.26 is available. Next, I'll install PHP 8.4 with the required extensions. Drupal requires: intl, mbstring (included in core), xml, xmlwriter, zip, gd, mysqlnd, curl, opcache, bcmath, sqlite3. The project requires ext-xmlwriter. Composer requires curl/zip etc.

Installation: php8.4-cli php8.4-intl php8.4-mbstring php8.4-xml php8.4-zip php8.4-gd php8.4-mysql php8.4-bcmath php8.4-sqlite3 php8.4-curl php8.4-opcache unzip

action.command:
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get install -y -qq php8.4-cli php8.4-intl php8.4-mbstring php8.4-xml php8.4-zip php8.4-gd php8.4-mysql php8.4-bcmath php8.4-sqlite3 php8.4-curl php8.4-opcache unzip 2>&1 | tail -3
php8.4 -v | head -2
php8.4 -m | grep -iE "intl|mbstring|xmlwriter|zip|gd|pdo_mysql|curl|bcmath" | tr '\n' ' '
